source_pointers: coordination/pending-ideas/BATCH-fe6992/tasks/TASK-20260909-d9fe48/design-report.md: fixed source panels, generated-ideal Hilbert paragraph
unresolved_requirements.finding: The contract and design report attribute (1-t^2)^2/(1-t)^3 to the generated homogeneous ideals J_A and J_B, without explicitly naming whether the graded module is J or R/J. That rational function is the quotient-ring series H_(R/J), whereas the ideal-module series H_J is (2t^2-t^4)/(1-t)^3. The complete finite 0..6 check and concrete formal target inherit the untyped word Hilbert.
unresolved_requirements.minimal_discriminator: All three source homogeneous ideals A/B/CI are generated in degree 2, so J_0=0. In contrast (R/J)_0=k and the displayed rational function has constant coefficient 1. Thus a literal graded-ideal implementation and a quotient-ring implementation produce different registered degree-0 values, despite both correctly detecting equal profiles.
unresolved_requirements.manual_basis: The exact sequence 0 -> J -> R -> R/J -> 0 gives H_J=H_R-H_(R/J). The regular-sequence outline supports H_(R/J)=(1-t^2)^2/(1-t)^3; it does not make that expression the series of J.
unresolved_requirements.primary_source_relation: Caminata-Gorla, printed page 5, explicitly uses HF_I(d)=dim_k I_d for a homogeneous ideal I. This strengthens the need to identify the module instead of silently importing a quotient convention.
